findings.claim: Native financial rules compute Transfer, Originate, Accrue and Repay from raw structural inputs; Python transports lexical JSON/KAST and compares decoded outputs. No host financial POST, effect list, validity flag or acceptance verdict is supplied as native semantic input.

All 125 expression and 104 lifecycle raw stdout captures were re-decoded and compared against complete expected results. Every corresponding K input was independently reconstructed from fixtures, substituting actual preceding native results on chained cases. All 229 native commands recorded return code zero without timeout.

The four-stage chain has principal/accrued/outstanding 100/0/100, 100/10/110, 80/0/80, 0/0/0; work remaining 413,348,260,174; liability incurred stays110 through repayments. Native result equality covers complete ordinary state, financial state, effects, work and full rejection diagnostics.

Source review confirms static admission precedes execution, financial state admission precedes guards, batch/kernel execution precedes Ensure suffix, and all rejection routes clear tentative financial post/effects/writes. Repayment preserves gross allowance spent, liability incurred, cursors and retained identity histories.

38 requirement IDs are covered by 36 lifecycle fixture groups, metadata-depth cases in the expression suite, and six offline comparator-corruption controls. Three Source-only static controls supplement post-scope/units. These are not 38 separate native lifecycle properties or exhaustive proofs.

UTF-8 byte hook accounting, strict byte-escape decoding, UTF-16 leading/continuation-byte accounting and quoted JSON counts agree with the 16 added boundary cases and six direct native probes; all six direct outputs were independently recomputed with Python encodings.

The executable lineage is the new Debian K7.1.337 WSL build, not the lost historical Nix artifact. Historical failures remain evidence of their original attempts. Current bound compiled artifacts and current captures agree; earlier successful prefixes are not counted as replacement for the full current runs.
